text:
mike_sales: Quick sync — Federal agency pilot just moved to POC approval. They require SSO + customer-managed KMS answers, and need a capacity/cost ballpark by EOW. Can we get a draft and an ops/RF Qs list?
elaine_se: I can own the security Qs (SSO, KMS, audit logs). Will need the env (VPC vs hosted) and whether they want on-prem keys.
devon_infra: @elaine_se if they want CMK in KMS + VPC routing it's doable in Private; on-prem HSM adds lead time. For capacity: what are the traffic expectations?
mike_sales: They gave a high-level profile: ~120 QPS spike expected, steady-state ~40 QPS after warm-up. Avg prompt+completion ~800 tokens. Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for the primary route. Budget: initial 3-week pilot, modest budget but potential for expansion.
nisha_cs: Success criteria we care about: (1) functional correctness on 5 eval prompt sets, (2) latency SLO met for 95% requests, (3) no data exfil incidents and audit logs enabled. I'll draft a checklist.
devon_infra: Quick back-of-envelope GPU sizing:
```
qps_peak = 120
avg_tokens_per_req = 800
tokens_per_sec = qps_peak * avg_tokens_per_req = 96_000 t/s
assume per-GPU sustained throughput ~24_000 t/s (quantized 70B-ish on A100/H100 tuned runtime)
gpus_needed = ceil(96000 / 24000) = 4
```
So plan for 4 dedicated GPUs for pilot headroom; 3 could work with tighter batching but we shouldn't overcommit.
mike_sales: Good — can you add cost estimate? They asked for a monthlyized number we can show procurement.
devon_infra: Rough cost (reserved/dedicated estimate):
- 4 GPUs * 720h/month * $6/hr (infra blended rate) = $17,280/month
- storage/network + infra tax ~ $2k/month
Total ~ $19.3k/month (pilot pro-rated for 3 weeks -> ~$10k)
Note: hosted fallbacks (smaller model) can reduce GPU needs by ~2x for non-critical routes.
elaine_se: Security notes: need to confirm MFA + SAML config, KMS customer-managed key, logging retention (they want 1y), and an ATO checklist item for data residency. I'll build the answers and ping legal.
nisha_cs: I'll draft success criteria doc and add the 5 eval prompts. Proposed pass = >=90% match on extraction/intent tests and p95 latency <400ms.
infra-bot: Deploy runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/pilot-deploy-checklist (last updated 2025-09-02) :package:
mike_sales: Action items: @elaine_se security Qs by Wed, @devon_infra final sizing + region suggestion by Thu, @nisha_cs success criteria + eval set by Thu EOD. I'll prep the budget slide for procurement.
devon_infra: Region suggestion: use us-west-2 for capacity + Fed-compliance options (govcloud if they require). If they want HSM we need 2-3 week lead.
elaine_se: noted. Also check whether they require IP allowlisting + SCIM for user provisioning.
nisha_cs: I'll add a rollback metric (error rate <1% and fall back to hosted smaller model).
mike_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: — if we can get these in the next 48h I can lock the kickoff date with the customer.
